intent.oneSentence: A finite flow of water pours from an elevated lip, steepens under gravity, lands in a shallow spreading pool and leaves small falling drops and ripples as it drains.
intent.firstRead: Falling liquid feeding a wet spreading surface.
intent.mustNotReadAs: A blue glowing comet, energy beam, identical noodles, solid blue hose, or unexplained exploding circle.
intent.useContext: Native pixel effect over dark, light and patterned game backgrounds.

readability.primaryShape: One connected descending stream with transported unequal bulges, narrowing under acceleration, ending at a broad low pool.
readability.focalPoint: Small white reflected glints at the wet contact and lit stream edges, not an emissive core.
readability.depthAndOverlap: Low pool behind falling stream; rear and near droplets remain separate.
readability.contrast: Transmitting midtones, shaded underside and short bright reflection fragments.
readability.secondaryDetailBudget: Sparse short-tailed drops detach from the stream and smaller splash drops begin at actual contact.

mechanics.source: A fixed elevated wet lip supplies a finite amount of water.
mechanics.driver: Downward initial velocity and gravity accelerate parcels; retained sideways momentum bends the stream.
mechanics.direction: Mostly down with modest rightward travel, then lateral spreading on the receiving plane.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Non-emissive translucent liquid, with reflected highlights and round detached drops.
mechanics.causalChain: Source start and cutoff travel with the falling parcels. The matching ballistic landing time starts surface spreading and local secondary splashes.
mechanics.endingRule: The last source parcel lands, droplets finish falling and low waves widen and thin into the receiving surface.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: Analytic stylized water flow, not Navier-Stokes, optical refraction, collision with arbitrary scenes, or an Unreal/Niagara implementation.

phases.name: action
phases.action: The elevated source opens, with the leading liquid traveling down.
phases.visibleCue: A growing continuous fall and delayed first contact.

phases.name: response
phases.action: Incoming water spreads and emits falling splash droplets.
phases.visibleCue: Low pool, outward waves and small ballistic beads.

phases.name: ending
phases.action: The cutoff travels down, all drops land, and low remaining water thins.
phases.visibleCue: The source clears first, then the lower flow and final surface traces.

omittedPhases.preparation: No charge-up or external actor is assumed; the source opening is the first visible event.

references.observed: Seekable ballistic drops, matching impact times, translucent flow and contact-led surface response already exist.
references.application: Reuse motion and impact primitives, narrow color-buffer reflections and curved wet surfaces without existing emissive rings.
references.limits: New renderer remains provisional until actual native output is inspected; no full-speed viewing or user approval is recorded.
